tool.name: MultiModal Learner
tool.command: #if $raw_data unzip -o -q '$raw_data' -d ./; #end if python '$__tool_directory__/multimodal_learner.py' --input_csv_train '$input_csv_train' --input_csv_test '$input_csv_test' --target_column '$target_column' --output_csv '$model_metrics' #if $threshold not in (None, '') --threshold '$threshold' #end if

param.name: target_column
param.label: Does your uploaded data include a target column? If so, please select the target column:

param.name: threshold
param.label: Decision Threshold (binary only)
param.help: If set, use this probability cutoff (0–1) for converting probabilities to labels on all splits. Default is 0.5.
